google_cloud_storage_new_bucket_trigger.description: Runs when new bucket is observed in Google Cloud Storage. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

google_cloud_storage_new_object_trigger.description: Runs when new object is observed in Google Cloud Storage. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.

google_cloud_storage_new_or_updated_obje.description: Runs when new or updated object is observed in Google Cloud Storage. Existing records establish the initial baseline. Polling follows your workspace plan; snapshots are limited to 4,000 records.
